messages:
maria: Heads up — RFC draft for changing the console/analytics event envelope is in the doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/ingest-envelope-v2
kevin: skimmed. high level: drop `route_meta` JSONB, add normalized `route_tags` table + route_id canonicalization? worried about dashboard queries that JOIN route_meta currently
joel: exact concern. dashboards do a lot of lateral jsonb -> unnest ops. joins to a proper table will be faster, but backfills are heavy
sam: +1 to normalized tags for query perf. main ops issue: how do we handle partial writes during migration (dual-write vs shadow-write)?
maria: proposal: shadow-write v2 to new tables, keep writing envelopev1 for 3 weeks. then run backfill in small windows and switch read adapter per-tenant. fallback policy if read-adapter misses keys
ingest-bot: deploy triggered: ingest-shim v2 canary -> infra-qa at 1766667200
kevin: can we get an example backfill SQL? want to estimate runtime for 100k routes
joel: sample backfill (rough):

```
INSERT INTO route_tags(route_id, tag_key, tag_value)
SELECT e->>'route_id', kv.key, kv.value
FROM console_events env
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(env->'route_meta') AS kv(key, value)
WHERE env->'envelope_version' = 'v1'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM route_tags rt WHERE rt.route_id = e->>'route_id' AND rt.tag_key = kv.key);
```

joel: that will need batching by route_id ranges and run on a read-replica to avoid primary impact
sam: ops checklist idea:
- shadow-write in ingest for 3 weeks
- backfill in 6h windows (low traffic) using route_id buckets
- add read-adapter feature flag per-tenant
- monitor console p99 and cohort dashboards
maria: alerting: create temporary p50/p95/p99 dashboards for console queries and a `migration/error-rate` SLI
kevin: what about quota calculations? current quota pipeline reads route_meta for plan tags (e.g., enterprise:true). If we move tags to route_tags, quota pipeline needs migration too
dmitri: quota engine suggestion: add a fallback join to route_meta until backfill complete. i.e., prefer route_tags, fallback to jsonb route_meta. Then remove fallback after full backfill + 2 weeks
maria: rollout UX: when a tenant flips to v2 read-adapter, console should show a small banner: "Using modernized route metadata — some historical metrics may be delayed"
joel: curious about index design: route_tags (route_id, tag_key, tag_value) with multicolumn index on (tag_key, tag_value) for select-by-tag queries
sam: + consider a combined materialized view for most common dashboard queries to avoid many distributed joins
kevin: still worried about space: route_meta is often sparse — normalized table will blow up rows. Need compression plan
maria: mitigation: store only tag keys used by console/quotas (whitelist) initially. Keep full route_meta in cold storage snapshot for future lookups
ingest-bot: canary health: ingest-shim v2 metrics: events_proxied=3421, shadow_error_rate=0.1% at 1766667421
dmitri: testcases: write adapter tests for mixed reads (some tags in route_tags, some only in route_meta) and long tail with >500 tags
kevin: agree. I'll open a GH PR with adapter + fallback logic and perf tests
maria: great. next sync: Wednesday 10am. Action items: Joel: backfill playbook draft. Sam: run a cost estimate for normalized rows. Kevin: PR for adapter. Dmitri: quota fallback patch. I'll update the RFC after those and schedule canary windows. :thumbsup:
